high_level_description: The image shows a man, presumably Prime Minister Modi, stepping out of an aircraft. He is dressed in traditional Indian attire, which includes a white kurta, a black vest, and white pants. The man is waving with his right hand, indicating a gesture of greeting or farewell. The aircraft has a logo on the top left corner, which appears to be the emblem of the Indian government, featuring a lion and other symbols. The aircraft door is open, and there is a staircase leading down from the plane, suggesting that the man is either arriving or departing.
